DisplayName.value: Chaotic's Reach - Craft From Nearby Containers

Description.value: Stop hauling. Any storage you placed within 20 blocks of you counts as part of your inventory while crafting - the recipe stops being greyed out, and the ingredients are pulled from your chests when you hit craft. Only your own containers, never an un-looted world crate, and never a chest someone else locked. Radius is configurable. Needs installing on the client, and EAC off.
